credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably exceeds capital expenditure plus shareholder distributions, leaving an internal funding surplus after the disclosed dividend and buyback programme. This self-funding capacity supports the investment-grade-style liquidity profile and reduces reliance on incremental borrowings for routine capital needs.

Gross leverage sits well below the sector median on a same-definition basis, and the operating margin also exceeds the sector median, reflecting the scale economics of the wireless and fixed-line franchise. Free cash flow to debt is marginally above the sector median, confirming cash conversion is competitive.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows a heavy concentration of fixed-rate senior notes across multiple currencies with staggered maturities, plus commercial paper programmes in Mexican pesos and euros maturing within the year. Refinancing therefore depends on continued access to both local and international markets at acceptable spreads.

Interest coverage has weakened year on year and now trails the sector median, while EBITDA coverage also declined against the prior period. Rising gross interest expense relative to operating income narrows the cushion for further rate or currency pressure.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers gross interest expense several times over, and free cash flow to debt is marginally above the sector median, so debt service is comfortably met from recurring cash generation. Coverage nonetheless sits below the sector median and below the prior year, so the trend warrants monitoring.

The current ratio is below one and well below the sector median, reflecting a working-capital structure where current liabilities include short-dated commercial paper and maturing notes. Liquidity therefore leans on refinancing access and undrawn facilities rather than the balance-sheet current position.

overall_credit_view.text: Net leverage remains below the next risk-band boundary and gross leverage is far below the sector median, supporting a modest indicative financial risk profile. Leverage nonetheless rose year on year, and net leverage now exceeds the sector median on a comparable net-debt basis, so deleveraging is not yet evident.

Our forward view is that stable operating margins and self-funded capital spending should keep leverage near current levels, but the thin headroom to the cash-flow threshold means a modest EBITDA or cash-flow setback could shift the profile. The risk-factor disclosure offers limited granularity on specific exposures.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流穩健地超過資本支出加股東分派，在已披露的股息及回購計劃後仍留有內部資金盈餘。此自我融資能力支撐投資級式的流動性狀況，並減少對增量借款以應付日常資本需求的依賴。
按相同定義基準，總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，而營業利潤率亦高於行業中位數，反映無線及固網業務的規模經濟效益。自由現金流對債務比率略高於行業中位數，確認現金轉換具競爭力。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示固定利率優先票據高度集中於多種貨幣，到期日錯開，另有以墨西哥披索及歐元計值、於年內到期的商業票據計劃。因此再融資取決於能否繼續以可接受息差進入本地及國際市場。
利息覆蓋率按年轉弱，現時低於行業中位數，而 EBITDA 覆蓋率亦較上一期間下降。總利息支出相對營業收入上升，收窄了應對進一步利率或匯率壓力的緩衝。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運現金流覆蓋總利息支出數倍，而自由現金流對債務比率略高於行業中位數，故債務償付可從經常性現金產生中從容應付。然而覆蓋率仍低於行業中位數及低於上一年度，故趨勢值得監察。
流動比率低於一，且遠低於行業中位數，反映營運資金結構中流動負債包括短期商業票據及到期票據。因此流動性依賴再融資渠道及未提取融資額度，而非資產負債表的流動狀況。

overall_credit_view.text: 淨槓桿仍低於下一個風險區間界限，而總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，支撐溫和的指示性財務風險狀況。然而槓桿按年上升，且按可比淨債務基準，淨槓桿現時高於行業中位數，故去槓桿尚未顯現。
我們的前瞻觀點是，穩定的營業利潤率及自我融資的資本開支應使槓桿維持於當前水平附近，但對現金流門檻的緩衝薄弱，意味著 EBITDA 或現金流若出現溫和挫折，可能令狀況轉變。風險因素披露對具體風險敞口提供的細節有限。
